ENG.t1_desc: It is the basic spirit of Ezekiel Cosmetics Co., Ltd. to contribute to the local economy by providing satisfaction to customers and creating jobs through strict quality control in the spirit of creation and innovation.
ENG.t2_desc: The community's contribution to growing with customers based on honesty and credit as a transparent ethical enterprise is the fundamental spirit of Ezekiel Cosmetics Co., Ltd.
ENG.t3_desc: Ezekiel Cosmetics Co., Ltd. promises to contribute to the spirit of management to become a company that learns and serves customers and develops together in their lives.
ENG.t4_desc: In the future, Ezekiel Cosmetics Co., Ltd. specializes in R&D and manufacturing based on its innovative management ideology, and will continue to grow steadily and develop rapidly through new technology development and advancement of overseas markets by securing excellent research personnel.

CHN.t1_desc:
以创造与创新的精神，通过严格的质量控制让客户满意，
并创造就业机会为地方经济做出贡献。
CHN.t2_desc:
以诚实与信用为基础与客户共同成长，
作为透明伦理的企业为社区做出贡献。
CHN.t3_desc:
以西结化妆品（株）承诺以正道经营的精神向客户学习和奉献，
成为与客户的生活共同发展的公司。
CHN.t4_desc:
未来，以西结化妆品(株)作为以创新经营理念为基础的专业研发和制造企业，
将通过领先的营销策略开拓国内外市场，实现持续和飞跃性的发展。
